//: Typechecks the Playwright harness, which no workspace tsconfig covers.
`e2e/` is deliberately not a pnpm workspace (`repo-structure.md` §7 places it at the
root with its own config), so `turbo run typecheck` never sees it. Without this file the
specs and the config would be the only TypeScript in the repository that nothing checks —
which is the exact hole `services/api/tsconfig.test.json` and
`packages/shared/tsconfig.test.json` were each added to close, both times after unchecked
test code hid a real defect.
Run by `pnpm typecheck:e2e`, which `verify` and CI's `validate` job both call. It emits
`module: commonjs` is not a style choice. Playwright transpiles these files to CommonJS —
the nearest package.json has no `type: module` — so `__dirname` is what they can use and
`import.meta` is a runtime syntax error. Typechecking them as ESM would accept code that
cannot load, which is how both `import.meta` versions of this config got written before
`verbatimModuleSyntax` is off for the same reason it is on everywhere else: it exists to
stop TypeScript rewriting import syntax, and here the rewriting is the point — the files
are authored as ESM and loaded as CJS, which is precisely the combination it forbids.
